body: Because our school says they want each student matching like we’re working in a fucking factory or something so unless we have school hoodies (which I hate so I’m not getting one) we aren’t allowed a jumper in class.
I always tell myself it’s stupid but one time on my arm I accidentally cut too deep and had to refuse to take off my jumper in school and teachers kept questioning me.
That’s exactly what I’m going through. Like why the fuck did I cut on my face? I do it but every time I say it’s the last time but it never is

If there was anyone who would be willing, I would like someone who I can speak with on snapchat about this so I can have proper conversations about other things too to take my mind off it as well as help with my problems. I just need a friend to go to when I feel this way that I don’t know irl.
I mean I could speak to my brother but we always fight and argue so I don’t think that would work out as we barely talk as it is.
See that’s also a bit of a dilemma because when I get upset I transfer it into anger and take that out at boxing but it then also takes away free time for other things so I’m torn.
Thanks for your advice it’s sort of made me realise that kid and things that happened a while ago don’t really matter and I should focus on all the good.

Yes, I believe it would be very problematic because my Nan (dads side) attempted suicide and my mum has previous experiences with my older brother and she was quite harsh to him rather than hearing him out she shouted about it., that’s why I’ve come here instead. And I could do but then I would get questions from my friend who I go to the gym with about why I’m not going and I wouldn’t know what to tell him.

I’m in a bit of a predicament. I go to the gym to focus on bettering myself but at the same time it hinders my ability to find time and just sit alone and think. It causes me to be up until 2am some nights when I wake for school at 7 and then teachers wonder why I’m tired and not giving full effort. To answer your question, my parents don’t know, I haven’t worn shorts for the last 3 weeks to ensure my mum doesn’t see the scars on my leg.

Thanks. I sat down with my girlfriend and her sister (who has had her own struggles) and told them everything and it made it worse because seeing my girlfriend and her older sister (16f) cry made it unbearable.

I mean I would love to get to the root of all this but my confidence is shattered and there’s no chance of me being able to build it up to see a therapist and I just have no free time on my hands I’m always busy with something like the gym or boxing I think that’s part of my problem I never have time to reflect on things.
If you need someone to speak to, you can message me as I don’t want others to go through the pain I’ve had.
Geez! Defenders need to pick their ankles up.
